C1100.title: Ministry of Public Security Reports Cracking 79 Cases Involving AI Face-Swapping
C1100.summary: On August 10, 2023, the Ministry of Public Security held a press conference announcing that in response to fraud targeting the public through AI face-swapping, authorities launched a special operation, solving 79 related cases and apprehending 515 suspects.
